promise.equal_rules.pledge: The rules apply to everyone, or they apply to no one.
promise.transparency.pledge: Nothing that touches the public should happen in the dark.
promise.constituents.pledge: When they ask which number is real, they get an answer.
promise.major_change.pledge: I told them this time would be different.
promise.independence.pledge: I answer to the people, not to the room.
record.empty: You never said the thing that could be broken.
card.act_echo_inaugural.text: The same chamber, a year on. Same podium, better suit, a speech your office prepared without asking what you believe. Halfway down the page, a line contradicts something you said from this exact spot, your first week. Nobody in the room remembers it. You do.
card.act_echo_inaugural.left: Say it again, and mean it.
card.act_echo_inaugural.right: Give the speech they're expecting now.
card.act3_authority_vote_betrayal.text: The board is lit and waiting for your key. Voting the room's way is not the same as letting it pass — one is a hand raised, the other a hand withheld. You know the difference. You are the only one here who will remember which you chose.
card.act3_reformist_confrontation.text.v: "'The rules apply to everyone, or they apply to no one,'" the Reformist says — on the record, microphones live. "Your words. Your first week. I'll keep quoting them, every session, until one of us stops being here."

"'Nothing that touches the public should happen in the dark,'" the Reformist says — on the record, microphones live. "That was your first speech. I'll keep quoting it, every session, until one of us stops being here."

"'I answer to the people, not to the room,'" the Reformist says — on the record, microphones live. "You said that before any of this. I'll keep saying it back to you, every session, until one of us stops being here."

"I keep waiting for the version of you that argues back on principle," the Reformist says. "There isn't one. You never said the thing I could hold you to. That turns out to be its own kind of answer."
